reviews.comment: One of the best profs at A&M. Extremely passionate about the material and willing to help students out. Asks difficult and sometimes confusing questions but to get an A/B in the class: make a quizlet over all the material he covers and practice it before exam time. This will set you up for success and practice any diagrams he gives you.

Dr. Zoran is really great, really knowledgeable. His lectures can be a bit difficult to follow sometimes, but that's also because of the difficulty of the material. Exams are pretty tough (B/C average) and the questions are really confusing sometimes. But overall, he's a wonderful professor who cares about his students!
This is one of the best classes I have ever taken. He is an awesome professor, super fair and caring, and really funny in lectures! Love this class and him. One of my favorite professors

Dr. Zoran is super caring and I really enjoyed going to lecture! He always told funny stories related to biology and he has a great sense of humor. The lab is easy and straightforward, and the lecture is just exams and LC participation. You have to know the material really well but it's doable if you pay attention and go to class!

Dr. Zoran is one of my favorite professors. You can tell that he cares so much about his students. His exams are fair and the lab is an easy A. Make sure you go to class because he'll ask questions for participation.

Overall fantastic professor, and goes out of his way to teach his students. Very respectful of his students, cares that they learn, and goes beyond in all ways to ensure that he facilitates a proper learning environment. Would instantly take a class by him again without a second thought.
